AI + Full Stack Development Intern — Axonari Software, Jaipur
Experience: 0–1 year / Freshers welcome
Key Responsibilities
- Build and maintain full-stack web applications using React, Next.js, and Node.js
- Develop AI-powered features, agents, and automations using LLM APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, and Gemini
- Build and integrate REST APIs and third-party services
- Work with databases and backend services
- Use modern AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Cursor to accelerate development
- Debug, test, and improve applications
- Collaborate with developers to turn requirements into working features
Required Skills
- React.js, Next.js, and Node.js
- JavaScript / TypeScript
- Understanding of REST APIs and basic database concepts
- Git and GitHub
- Good problem-solving and debugging skills
- Ability to learn independently and work with technical documentation
Good to Have
- Experience with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar AI coding agents
- Experience with LLM APIs, chatbots, or AI agents
- Experience with PostgreSQL/MongoDB, n8n, or Vercel
